verified_facts.text: Guests staying at the hotel are invited to a complimentary 30-minute guided tour of the Peace Museum.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests staying at the hotel are also invited to discover its legendary heritage through a complimentary 30-minute guided tour of the Peace Museum

verified_facts.text: The Peace Museum traces the legacy of the former Cathay Hotel, the predecessor of Fairmont Peace Hotel, from 1929 to the present day.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Peace Museum traces the century-old legacy of the former Cathay Hotel, the predecessor of Fairmont Peace Hotel, from 1929 to the present day

verified_facts.text: The Cathay Room on the 9th floor was formerly Sir Sassoon's private banquet hall and has a 270-degree riverfront terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 9th floor, the Cathay Room was formerly Sir Sassoon's private banquet hall. It combines Art Deco elegance with a 270° riverfront terrace

verified_facts.text: The Jazz Bar hosts nightly performances by the Old Jazz Band, which holds a Guinness World Record.
verified_facts.excerpt: invites you to immerse in nightly performances by the Guinness World Record-holding Old Jazz Band

verified_facts.text: Dragon Phoenix is on the 8th floor and has dragon-phoenix ceiling motifs and red pillars with views of the Bund and Lujiazui.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 8th floor, the restaurant features dragon-phoenix ceiling motifs and red pillars with views of the Bund and Lujiazui.

verified_facts.text: The Sassoon Presidential Suite occupies the entire 10th floor penthouse, where the hotel's creator and former owner, Victor Sassoon, once lived.
verified_facts.excerpt: occupies the entire 10th floor penthouse of Fairmont Peace Hotel, where the hotel's creator and former owner, Victor Sassoon, once lived

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a series of country-themed suites, including a Japanese Suite with tatami mats and shoji screens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take off your shoes and step onto tatami mats with their straw-like fragrance and into soft light filtered through shoji screens

verified_facts.text: Fairmont Gold guests have access to a ninth-floor lounge with private check-in, complimentary breakfast and all-day refreshments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fairmont Gold guests enjoy elevated ensuite amenities plus access to a ninth-floor lounge for private check-in, complimentary breakfast and all-day refreshments

verified_facts.text: The hotel is on the Bund with views of Pudong across the Huangpu River.
verified_facts.excerpt: graces the Bund, offering breathtaking views of Pudong across the Huangpu River

verified_facts.text: The front door of the hotel opens onto Nanjing Street, and the rooms are well soundproofed.
verified_facts.excerpt: The front door of the hotel opens to Nanjing Street, home to popular shopping and dining.

verified_facts.text: An indoor pool is on level one, part of the Willow Stream Spa on the same floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: An indoor pool is on level one, part of the Willow Stream Spa on the same floor.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says this is not a family-focused hotel, and the hushed interiors are not ideal for young children.
verified_facts.excerpt: in general, this is not a family-focused hotel, and the hushed interiors of this hotel and its restaurants are not ideal for frolicking kiddos.

verified_facts.text: Indoor parking is included, with 20 parking spaces.
